results.name: all four map durations, bosses and increasing HP are shared deterministic rules
all maps instantiate 30 matching enemies, correct bosses and exact appearance thresholds
forest enemies remain airborne, with visible windup and swoop states instead of burrowing
glacier, caldera and reef enemies fire only matching ice, fire and water attacks
elemental bosses have different timed volley, breath, slide and rush patterns
boss defeat advances maps automatically while ordinary enemies remain alive
victory cannot be cancelled by a lingering attack or a fall during the defeat animation
page exit during a boss celebration records completion once before the next visit
fruit and vegetables auto-collect on desktop, once, without any key
weapons stay on the ground until E, on desktop and touch; only nearest weapon is claimed
every offered weapon in the outer pickup range can be collected by one explicit action
one action takes the nearest eligible weapon even if a farther drop is processed first
growth triggers at every 20-point boundary and leaves collision dimensions/footing stable
SQK world size is exactly 70% of the prior dimensions, and defeat remains idempotent
each weapon dispatches its own sound and retains original damage and ammo rules
guest scores never become a global board and existing local data stays untouched
guest Lifetime Score is a visit-only personal best while produce growth still adds across runs
